Admission tickets cover the entire weekend so that everyone can come and go to match the weather as best as possible.
Balloon flights are a magical business and also subject to the weather.
If a balloon flight is cancelled due to weather, it is refundable to all those who were on site during check in.
They may wait as late as 7:30 to see if the winds will settle and the weather is favorable for flying.
Balloon rides are weather-dependent and may be delayed or canceled at the discretion of the pilot and Balloonmeister for safety reasons.
If your flight is delayed, please note that delays are non-refundable and will not exceed three hours.
